name: Acropolis of Athens
_about: The Acropolis: each building painted as it is alone (its own finish, used for its component: arch/finish.js withUses) -- the Parthenon, the Erechtheion, the Propylaia, the temple of Athena Nike; the rock its grey limestone weathered ochre (palette acropolis-rock), the circuit walls of squared limestone, the stair, the bases and the altar of marble.
